notes: GOFAST (NAVAIR FOIA release, 2015). FOV 0.7 deg from the HUD NAR label (secondary sources). Ranges from the HUD RNG readout 4.4->3.4 NM. Observer velocity and background range from HUD Mach/altitude/gimbal angles, wings level assumed.

The HUD label -> FOV table is user-supplied; the label is the only provenance. HUD zoom labels are often digital zoom levels, not optical FOVs, and the same label can mean different FOVs on different sensors.

Active image region x=104..531, y=27..455: the HFOV is that of the 427-px-wide inset, with the principal point at its centre. Apply it with the same region (kin_params.image_region) or crop the video to the inset; applied to the full 640-px frame it would overstate every angle by 1.5x.
Every angular rate (deg/s, deg/s²) and every scenario value (m/s, g) scales linearly with the HFOV, so this relative uncertainty applies to them unchanged (it is not included in their ±1σ).
